_comment: Vestas V126-3.45 reference curve as applied by Bazefield at McCrae (TheoreticalPower vs 5-min WindSpeedAvg). Rebuilt 2026-10-20 from 253,841 five-minute pairs on 12 MCW02 turbines, 2026-08-05..10-19; 0.5 m/s bin medians; rated 3,450 kW from 13 m/s; cut-out 22.5 m/s (Vestas V126-3.45 spec - highest observed 10-min wind 23.3 m/s).
turbine: Vestas V126-3.45 (MCW02, 126 m rotor, 87 m hub)
